newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover slipped to 931 million yuan from 1.0039 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said both short-term financial centres and banks were reluctant to trade, resulting in shrinking volume.
Only some non-banking financial institutions, including securities houses, traded a little through the second-tier market, they said.
Securities houses are only allowed to borrow for one day and are prohibited from using the money to trade on the stock markets, limiting their impact on interbank rates, they said.
Rates were likely to remain low-key in the next few days on an absence of market-moving news.
